name: Iowa Prairie Network Small Grants Program
summary: Small grants of $500 to $3,000 for prairie restoration, management or protection projects, plus research, monitoring, education and training, with highest consideration for Iowa's old-growth remnant prairies.

geography.label: United States (priority for remnant prairies in Iowa)

status.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

deadline.quote: Submit your proposal via email by November 30, 2026, to be considered for funding effective January 31, 2027.

geography.quote: Projects with positive expected impacts to Iowa's old growth, remnant prairies will receive highest consideration.
